svg.aria-label: Two jobs on one CPU core: 4.03 s one after the other, 2.44 s together
svg.title: Two jobs on one CPU core: 4.03 s one after the other, 2.44 s together
svg.text: Two jobs on one CPU core: 4.03 s one after the other, 2.44 s together
Measured on Linux with jobs.c: the CPU job computes for 2 s; the I/O job computes 10 ms, then waits 40 ms, 40 times.
CPU idle: the only job is waiting for I/O
Schematic: the real run had about 650 context switches, too many to draw. The I/O job's bursts are drawn wider than to scale.
